1981-2415-7192-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Grave Venerations and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Defiant Salvager's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

339-677-4742-8095.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3413-4050-5929.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Leyline of Transformation, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.

4067-6609-7864.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a nonland permanent you control
4067-6609-7864.description:
Activate O'aka by tapping it and removing a counter from a nonland permanent, causing you to draw a card.
Ravenhill Flock triggers, putting a counter on it.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping O'aka.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2457-4289-5434-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1123-6797-6972.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Flayer of the Hatebound
When Flayer of the Hatebound dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Flayer of the Hatebound enters, it triggers, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Flayer of the Hatebound
When Flayer of the Hatebound dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Flayer of the Hatebound enters, it triggers, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Resolve both Phantom Train abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.
1123-6797-6972.notes: If Flayer of the Hatebound starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

uses.n: Grub, Storied Matriarch // Grub, Notorious Auntie

745-3439-4613-7196.description:
Cast Mirrorhall Mimic by paying {3}{U}. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Grub, Storied Matriarch.
Put Grub, Storied Matriach into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Mirrorhall Mimic enters, it triggers, returning Grub, Storied Matriarch from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Agatha's Soul Cauldron by tapping it and exiling Civilized Scholar from your graveyard, putting a +1/+1 counter on Mirrorhall Mimic.
Activate Mirrorhall Mimic using Civilized Scholar's ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and discard Grub, Storied Matriarch. Mirrorhall Mimic will then untap itself and transform, but it will transform again into Grub, Storied Matriarch.
Mirrorhall Mimic triggers, returning Grub, Storied Matriarch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 5.
745-3439-4613-7196.notes: This combo functions as Mirrorhall Mimic will only copy the characteristics from Grub, Storied Matriarch and not Grub, Notorious Auntie. This is outlined here: "712.8d While a double-faced permanent has its front face up, it has only the characteristics of its front face."

2908-4986-6798--44.description:
Cast an artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Dream Stalker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dream Stalker enters, it triggers, returning another artifact that can be cast for {0} from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the artifact spell cast in step 1.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dream Stalker
Repeat.
2908-4986-6798--44.notes: One of the {0} cost artifacts must be in your hand with the other on the battlefield.

1796-2034-4871-5795-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Barkform Harvester by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Centaur Omenreader.
Repeat.

1479-2841-3678-6159.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bloodstained Mire.
Your life total is at least 2.
1479-2841-3678-6159.description:
Fetch a land using Bloodstained Mire.
When the fetched land enters, Retreat to Emeria and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

3490-4017-4506-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4017-4506-5231.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

2478-2866-2981-4986.description:
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

3685-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven artifacts.
3685-6747.description:
Cast Spine of Ish Sah by paying {0} due to Sami.
When Spine of Ish Sah enters, its first ability triggers, destroying itself.
Spine of Ish Sah's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

3525-5115-6702--119.description:
Tap Kilo using any free method.
Kilo triggers, causing you to proliferate and putting a charge counter on Gemstone Array.
Activate Gemstone Array by removing a charge counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Kilo.
Repeat.
3525-5115-6702--119.notes: This combo will also give you infinite results from whatever method you use to tap Kilo.

2232-3504-6749.easyPrerequisites: You control six or more lands.
2232-3504-6749.description:
Cast Mercurial Pretender by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
When Mercurial Pretender enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Anticausal Vestige from the battlefield to your hand.
When Anticausal Vestige leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and and put Anticausal Vestige from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Anticausal Vestige enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Mercurial Pretender from the battlefield to your hand.
When Mercurial Pretender leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Mercurial Pretender from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
Repeat from step 2.

without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater

478-539-3717--111.description:
Activate Viridian Joiner by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Viridian Joiner.
Repeat.

1799-5231-5359-5497.description:
Activate Hoverstone Pilgrim by paying {2}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod four times by sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk and the Gnomes, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

116-745-5329.notablePrerequisites:
Mirrorhall Mimic on the battlefield as a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Mirrorhall Mimic do not have summoning sickness.
116-745-5329.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Mirrorhall Mimic.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Mirrorhall Mimic.
Activate Mirrorhall Mimic by tapping it, targeting Kiora's Follower.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Mirrorhall Mimic ability, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

1283-2440-2534-4183.notablePrerequisites: Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
1283-2440-2534-4183.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Coercive Recruiter with haste.
When the token Coercive Recruiter enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Coercive Recruiter trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Coercive Recruiter.
Repeat.

1659-2167-5626-5721.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least {E}{E}.
You control at least six mana-producing lands, one of which can tap to produce at least {B} and another of which can tap to produce at least {G}.
1659-2167-5626-5721.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a land, adding one mana of any color that land could produce.
Repeat step 1 until you have at least {4}{B}{G} available and/or you control no other mana-producing lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Seed the Land triggers that many times, creating that many creature tokens.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}, sacrificing a creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aftermath Analyst enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

2867-3698-4636-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 3/3 Robot artifact creature token.
When the Robot enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart and Grinding Station trigger.
Resolve the Gonti's Aether Heart trigger, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Robot.
When the Robot dies, Demon of Dark Schemes' second ability triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability, causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat.

864-1115-1312-2034-4871.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding {C}{C}.
When Eternal Witness dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Doomed Necromancer by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing it.
When Doomed Necromancer dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Doomed Necromancer ability, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Doomed Necromancer from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Doomed Necromancer by paying {2}{B}.
Repeat.

486-509-1267-5547.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
486-509-1267-5547.description:
Activate Liquimetal Torque's second ability by tapping it, causing Medomai the Ageless to become an artifact until end of turn.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris and Thrummingbird.
Idris and Thrummingbird trigger.
Resolve the Idris trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Thrummingbird trigger, putting a time counter on Idris.
Repeat from step 6.

1162-3008.notablePrerequisites: You control another transforming double-faced creature.
1162-3008.description:
Activate Blade of Shared Souls' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to another transforming double-faced creature you control.
Blade of Shared Souls triggers, causing the creature to become a copy of Enduring Angel.
Whenever your life total would be reduced to 0 or less, the creature with Blade of Shared Souls attached sets your life total to 3 instead and transforms itself.
Because Blade of Shared Souls remains attached to the creature, it continues being a copy of Enduring Angel despite transforming.
Repeat from step 3.

1634-3858-4244.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers.
Holding priority, cast Secure the Wastes by paying {5}{W}, creating five 1/1 Warrior creature tokens.
When the Warriors enter the battlefield, Devilish Valet triggers that many times, doubling its power that many times, causing its power to be at least 32 until end of turn.
Resolve the Mayael's Aria trigger, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain 10 life and win the game.

1189-1636-3730-3828.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one untapped Wolf.
Master of the Wild Hunt does not have summoning sickness.
1189-1636-3730-3828.description:
Activate Master of the Wild by tapping it, tapping all untapped Wolves you control, then causing them to deal damage to the creature with Druid's Call attached equal to their power, then having the creature with Druid's Call attached deal damage to the Wolves equal to its power.
Druid's Call triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens equal to the damage dealt.
When the Squirrel(s) enter the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers that many times, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1283-1350-2713-4617.description:
Activate Soulbright Flamekin twice by paying {2}, giving any two creatures trample until end of turn.
Activate Soulbright Flamekin by paying {1}, giving any creature trample until end of turn and adding eight {R}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {1}, returning Soulbright Flamekin from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Soulbright Flamekin by paying {2}.
Repeat.

1379-4027-4191.description:
Cast Glint Hawk without paying its mana cost.
Glint Hawk enters the battlefield, returning itself to your hand.
Repeat.

1584-2174-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Juniper Order Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Juniper Order Druid.
1584-2174-4222.description:
Activate Teferi's Isle by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping Teferi's Isle.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Juniper Order Druid.
Repeat any number of times.
